node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper SX-EW and nickel HPAL
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a more investable US-listed map around the acid chokepoint in North American acid production/regeneration, chemical distribution, tank-barge logistics, and competing fertilizer demand rather than pure copper or Indonesian HPAL producers. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are Ecovyst for virgin/regenerated sulphuric acid supply, Hawkins for distributed sulphuric-acid availability, and Kirby for bulk-liquid chemical logistics. Mosaic is included as a reference/adjacent demand-pressure name because sulphur cost shocks have already affected phosphate operations and could compete with metals customers for sulphur/acid feedstock. No trade recommendation is made.
